sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 200. Success value 100. 5x physical damage (Wind).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Applies a pressure state (prohibits switching with any surviving player in a Guild Battle) for 40 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 100. Applies stun.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Karma.
-Target: all allies. Applies Kismet.
-Target: all allies. Applies dual attack, reducing the cooldown time of the next Ability used to 0 (except for certain Abilities).
-Target: all allies. Increases Unison gauge gains by 3 for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases Cost recovery speed by 10 for 60 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Rage for 60 seconds (increases max HP, ATK, and MATK by 100%; nullifies status ailments and Cost reduction. When in effect, recovers 30% of your character's max HP, recovers 30 Cost, and removes debuffs/special debuffs when you defeat an enemy).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 9500
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 9500
